task_description: Make PahadPulse a presentation-ready, end-to-end 'real data + real dashboard' demo centered on The Forest Season Resort, Mussoorie. (1) Create The Forest Season Resort as the Home_Property of the Mussoorie cluster and GENERATE a realistic multi-platform (Google/MakeMyTrip/Booking.com/TripAdvisor/Agoda), multilingual (en/hi/hi-Latn), ~18-month review dataset FILE for it, then run that file through the REAL ingestion/collection pipeline (Review_Collector -> parse -> language/sentiment/aspect -> normaliser -> market model -> changepoints) - the honest meaning of 'scraping and all'; NO illegal live third-party scraping (no free credential-less path, violates platform terms/Req 2). (2) Deliver a working demo login: seeded owner/manager account for the resort with documented credentials, backend /auth/login issuing a signed session token (hashed passwords, roles, ~12h expiry, basic lockout), and a PRETTY frontend login page with a nice themed forest/mountain background. (3) Make the dashboard truly live - all 16 pages render live backend (resort) data as the source of truth, snapshots only as explicit offline fallback, with tidy loading/empty/error states. (4) Make the demo turn-key and FREE: documented single command (make demo), demo credentials, honesty note (synthetic-but-real-pipeline, live scraping needs official APIs), and FREE live-URL/deployment options (Codespaces public port, Vercel+free backend, free tunnel) with NO paid AWS/cloud provisioning. Keep all gates green (backend ruff+pytest, frontend lint+vitest+build). Do NOT push or open PRs - the orchestrator publishes.

In-process TestClient (live servers blocked by sandbox dev-server guard): after `uv run python -m app.seed` (idempotent), POST /auth/login with documented demo creds -> 200 scoped to 'The Forest Season Resort', GET /auth/me -> 200, wrong password -> 401; /market-radar/review-counts shows mus-forestseason with 52 reviews across all 5 platforms (Google 12, MakeMyTrip 10, Booking.com 9, TripAdvisor 11, Agoda 10); /health, /sentinel/board, /sentinel/metrics, /destination/heatmap, /concierge/facts, /market-radar/analytics/playbook (home='The Forest Season Resort'), /market-radar/analytics/what-if/Google, /guest-compass/stays, /minimal/forecast all 200. Test quality: new tests exercise real code paths (argon2 hash/verify roundtrip asserting non-plaintext; a real POST /market-radar/collection/upload ingestion asserting new_count==len(rows) then dedup new_count==0; generator determinism; home-property re-centering) and would fail if the implementation were reverted. No Dockerfile (devcontainer-only free deployment path), so docker_build skipped per the no-paid-cloud constraint.
